everland.benefit: Day pass ₩20,000 for you, ₩30,000 per companion
everland.condition: Up to 3 companions. Buy first through Smart Reservation, then show the original photo admission ticket (or early-admission application receipt or acceptance letter) and ID on site. Cannot be combined with other coupons or card deals.

lotteWorld.benefit: All-access pass ₩27,000 in Seoul, ₩20,000 in Busan
lotteWorld.condition: Test taker only. Show your 2027 admission ticket and ID at the on-site ticket booth.

lotteAquaSky.condition: Test taker only. Show your admission ticket and ID at the on-site ticket booth. Ends a month earlier than Adventure.

seoulLand.condition: Same price for you and up to 2 companions. Show one original (admission ticket, application receipt or early-admission acceptance) plus ID (student or youth ID accepted) at the ticket booth. Cannot be combined with other coupons or card deals.

legoland.condition: Up to 3 companions. On-site same-day purchase only (no online pre-purchase). 10% off regular-price gift shop items and food in the park.

seaLife.condition: Test taker only. No booking needed; show your admission ticket on site. 20% off food and souvenirs at COEX, 10% off souvenirs in Busan.

oWorld.condition: Test taker only. Show your admission ticket and ID at the on-site ticket booth.

aquaPlanetYeosu.condition: You and up to 1 companion. Ask Aqua Planet which proof it accepts before you go.

sono.brand: Sono water parks & Samaksan cable car
sono.condition: 8 water parks including Ocean World, plus the Chuncheon Samaksan Lake cable car. Up to 2 companions. Buy on the Sono Hotels & Resorts website by Dec 9 and use Nov 20 – Dec 31.

waterpia.condition: You and 1 companion. Ask the resort which proof it accepts before you go.

spaVis.benefit: Water park day pass ₩10,000 for you, ₩20,000 per companion
spaVis.condition: No limit on companions at ₩20,000 each. Show your admission ticket at entry.

cgv.condition: Members aged 13–18 get 2 coupons on the event page (first 5,000). At the box office, show your admission ticket or student ID. Members 19+ get a ₩3,000-off coupon.

megabox.condition: Teens download the coupon on the website or app event page. Adult test takers verify with their admission ticket at the box office.

arko.condition: 'Hongju' Nov 20–22, 'Freediving' Nov 27–29. Choose the test-taker discount when booking, up to 2 tickets per show including you. Show your admission ticket or early-admission acceptance when collecting tickets.

sweeneyTodd.benefit: 30% off R, S and A seats
sweeneyTodd.condition: Test taker only. Applies to shows from Dec 4 to Jan 17, 2027; book the test-taker ticket type. Bring your admission ticket and ID on the day.

christmasCarol.brand: Seoul Metropolitan Musical Theatre 'A Christmas Carol'
christmasCarol.condition: Sejong Center M Theater, Dec 2–27. Up to 2 tickets per person including the test taker.

gansong.condition: You and 1 companion. Show your admission ticket or early-admission acceptance.

shabuAllday.condition: Test taker only with the physical admission ticket, once per ticket. Companions pay full price; no stacking with other coupons. All stores.

kukuku.condition: Download the coupon in the Kukuku app and show your admission ticket and ID when paying.

restaurant63.condition: Walking on the Cloud, Shuchiku and Baekrihyang. Test taker only, 1 per table. Mention the test-taker discount when booking and bring your admission ticket and ID.

parkView.condition: Bring your admission ticket. Ask about companions when booking.

laGrillia.benefit: 50% off flat-iron steak and BBQ rib platter
laGrillia.condition: Order ₩50,000 or more, add the KakaoTalk channel and show your admission ticket or application receipt. Some stores excluded.

street.condition: Show your admission ticket or application receipt. Some stores, such as airport branches, excluded.

jejuAir.condition: You and 1 companion (an adult on the same booking). Book on the website or app by Dec 16 and fly by Feb 25, 2027 (peak dates excluded). Show one original (admission ticket, application receipt or university application) at the airport counter.

eastarJet.benefit: 25% off domestic, up to 10% off international
eastarJet.condition: You and 1 companion. Choose 'test taker' or 'test taker's companion' on the website, buy by Dec 31 and fly by Mar 27, 2027. Show proof such as your admission ticket at the airport.

trinity.benefit: 25% off domestic, up to 20% off international
trinity.condition: You and 1 companion. Book by Jan 31, 2027 and fly Nov 20 – Feb 21, 2027 (blackout dates vary by route). Show one original (admission ticket, application receipt or university application) at the airport; no photos or copies, and the companion checks in with you.

korailTour.condition: About 20 train packages, rail bikes and more. Companions on packages get the discount too. Bring your admission ticket on the trip.

forestStay.condition: 10 national forest welfare facilities. Book through Sup-e-rang and show your admission ticket on site.

himart.benefit: Storage upgrades or AirPods 4 with a smartphone purchase
himart.condition: With your admission ticket, worth up to ₩310,000 depending on the phone plan. No end date announced; check terms in store.

gyeongjuWorld.benefit: Day pass ₩24,000 for you, ₩27,000 per parent
gyeongjuWorld.condition: Up to 2 parents. Show your admission ticket (early-admission application, acceptance or waitlist proof also works) and ID; if your parents come, bring a family relationship certificate or similar.

aquaPlanetIlsan.benefit: Up to 50% off for you, 30% off companions
aquaPlanetIlsan.condition: Up to 3 companions. Ask Aqua Planet which proof and ticket types qualify before you go.

sehwa.benefit: Free entry for you and 1 companion
sehwa.condition: Show your CSAT admission ticket and ID.

kensington.condition: Applies to 1 test taker per table. Ask which proof is accepted when booking.

jwMarriott.condition: Weekday lunch and dinner only. Book by phone in advance and show your admission ticket or other proof on the day.

changgo43.condition: Show your admission ticket at any branch (Changgo 43 On at Hyundai Jungdong gives a small half-moon beef pancake instead). Cannot be combined with other coupons or events.

outback.condition: Bring your 2027 CSAT admission ticket and spend ₩70,000 or more to get Gold Coast Coconut Shrimp. Once per table per day.

junoHair.benefit: 50% off for you, 30% off for 1 companion
junoHair.condition: Show your admission ticket or other proof that you took the test. Cannot be combined with other discounts. Spend ₩200,000 or more in a day for a free brand gift (while supplies last).

skt.benefit: 30% off Groundseesaw shows, 2-month Google AI Plus coupon
skt.condition: For SKT customers who took the test. Groundseesaw exhibitions are 30% off with a coupon when you book on NOL (up to 4 tickets each); the 'T Universe' Google AI Plus coupon goes to the first 5,000. New lines and device upgrades also get 2 Lotte Cinema tickets (first 5,000) and a ₩5,000 baro plan coupon. Sign up on SKT's test-taker promotion page.

guide.title: Before you use your admission ticket

prep.title: What to bring
items: Bring the original admission ticket and a photo ID (student ID, youth ID, resident card, passport or mobile ID). Most places check both.
Many places do not accept a phone photo or a copy of the ticket. Some airlines say they accept originals only.
Some places accept an application receipt or early-admission acceptance instead (Seoul Land, Everland, Jeju Air and others). Check each card's terms.
Some deals need advance booking (Everland Smart Reservation, Sono website, flights), while others only work on site (LEGOLAND, Seoul Land).

who.title: Repeat test takers and GED graduates
items: Most deals are for anyone who sat the 2027 CSAT, so repeat test takers and GED graduates qualify with this year's admission ticket.
Age-based deals such as cinema teen coupons may not reach adult test takers in the app. Verify with your admission ticket at the box office instead.
Last year's (2026) admission ticket does not count. Check the year printed on your ticket.

lost.title: If you lost your admission ticket
items: See whether the place accepts an application receipt or early-admission acceptance. Seoul Land, Jeju Air and Trinity Airways accept original receipts.
Ask where you applied (your school or the district education office) whether the ticket can be reissued.
Whether the score report (issued Dec 11) counts as proof differs by company. Call before you go.

rules.title: Companion and stacking rules
items: Companion discounts need you to enter together or book on the same reservation. The number of companions ranges from 1 to 3.
Test-taker discounts usually cannot be combined with other coupons, card deals or memberships. Pick the cheaper one.
Some places allow one use per ticket (Shabu Allday), others allow repeat visits during the period (LEGOLAND).
Events can end early or change, and first-come coupons can run out before the end date.

items.q: Can I get the discount with just a photo of my admission ticket?
items.a: Usually not. Theme parks and airlines often check the original ticket and ID, and some, like Trinity Airways, say photos and copies are not accepted. Bring the original.

items.q: Do repeat test takers get the discounts too?
items.a: Yes. Most deals are for anyone who sat the 2027 CSAT regardless of age. Age-based offers like cinema teen coupons may need verification with your admission ticket at the box office.

items.q: I lost my admission ticket. Can I use another document?
items.a: Seoul Land also accepts the original application receipt or early-admission acceptance, and Jeju Air and Trinity Airways accept the original application receipt or university application. Accepted documents differ, so check each card and ask in advance.

items.q: How many companions get the discount?
items.a: Three at Everland, LEGOLAND and Aqua Planet Ilsan & Gwanggyo, two at Seoul Land and Sono water parks, and one for the airlines, Aqua Planet Yeosu and Juno Hair. Gyeongju World allows up to two parents. Asan Spavis has no limit at ₩20,000 each. Companions must enter with you or book on the same reservation.

items.q: Can I combine the test-taker discount with a card discount?
items.a: Usually not. Everland and Seoul Land say it cannot be combined with other coupons or card deals. If your card discount is bigger, that may be the better choice.

items.q: Can I just show my ticket at Everland?
items.a: No. At Everland you buy the pass through Smart Reservation first, then show your admission ticket and ID on site. LEGOLAND is the opposite: the discount only applies to same-day purchases at the ticket booth.

items.q: Can a deal end before the listed date?
items.a: Yes. First-come offers like the CGV coupons can run out, and companies can change or end events early. This page was checked on Nov 22, 2026, so confirm with the source link before you go.

sources.title: Sources and how we checked
sources.body: Each card links to the company's notice or a news report quoting the company. We left out events found only on blogs, events where sources disagree on prices or dates, and last year's (2026) events.
sources.asOf: Checked on Nov 22, 2026. We will update this page when new events appear or terms change.
